summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the conclusion of its shareholder consultation on its 2026 Directors' Remuneration Policy and Performance Share Plan, which received less than 80% shareholder support at the May 2026 AGM. After engaging with shareholders representing about 70% of issued share capital and proxy advisors from May to July 2026, the board adopted the policy and plan as originally approved. It also granted top-up equity awards to CEO Deepak Nath on 1 September 2026, including PSP shares worth 350% of salary and RSP shares worth 25% of salary. This is routine executive compensation disclosure with no special-situation transaction.
